# roadster.game

> A free 3D browser game: fly a two-seat flying roadster from Earth orbit to Mars. Built by Aswini (https://www.linkedin.com/in/iam-aswini).

## What it is
- Landing page: a silver two-seat roadster hovers on four lift modules above a night desert, then climbs into orbit as you scroll.
- The Mars Run: a one-way flight course from a launch gate above Earth, through ring gates and an asteroid field, to an arrival gate in Mars orbit. The HUD counts down the 54.6 million km to Mars.
- Vehicles: Street, Thrust and Flight variants; a finish studio for paint colour, metallic, roughness, clearcoat and wheel finish; .glb export.

## How to play
- W / S: thrust and brake
- A / D: steer
- Up / Down arrows: climb and dive
- Shift: boost (fly through red boost rings to recharge)
- Space: air-brake
- Esc: pause
- Phones: on-screen touch controls

## Facts
- Free, no download, runs in any WebGL browser on desktop and mobile.
- Built with React, TypeScript, Three.js and React Three Fiber.
- Independent prototype, not affiliated with Tesla or any automaker. Vehicle and world are original work.
- Author: Aswini, https://www.linkedin.com/in/iam-aswini
